author: Mehrp
body:
So I was browsing my subscriptions when I found a nice TED talk. It was about psychopathy and was quite interesting so I then decided to take a few tests. Here are some I found:
http://www.playbuzz.com/gregs/can-you-pass-the-psychopath-test 
http://www.kevindutton.co.uk/psychopath-challenge.php
http://personality-testing.info/tests/LSRP.php 
Have a go at them and see what results you get :P
Mine are as follows:
https://gyazo.com/2fbc26cb35c9f1b9f7fac29b859e7268
https://gyazo.com/0f734796c64dcca6efdf80daa002f322
https://gyazo.com/0fecf57b0313d0a0dbae577707f7a1cb
Yeah. I kinda knew I had a lack of empathy in some way, turns out it makes me a psychopath!
________________________________________________________________________________________________________
Post your results below and any conversation surrounding it ^-^
